anchor_definition: The anchor is the request interceptor (x) whose body generates a uuid and binds it to the request's reqId field (t.data.reqId = l()()). It is not requestKey (the search call-site that invokes the http wrapper) nor the uuid library itself (a reusable primitive). PLAN §8.14 rule 1: the field-binding interceptor outranks the generic uuid generator it calls.

anchor.why: The axios request interceptor: generates n = l()() (a v1 uuid) and assigns t.data.reqId = n (and plat/from/httpsStatus). This is where the observed reqId request parameter is produced and attached.

roles.why: The search box handler that builds the search param and calls the http wrapper Object(o.a)(param); it triggers the request but does not itself generate reqId.
Formats the search-suggestion results for display; not on the reqId generation path.
